title.narrative: Strengthening Peace and Resilience through the Development of Key Economic Corridors in West Africa

description.narrative:
The project “Strengthening peace and resilience through economic development corridors in West Africa” is a study aimed at generating knowledge that supports informed decision-making to improve AfDB contributions to resilience and peace in key economic corridors of West Africa. Through its priorities, the project aligns with the United Nations New Urban Agenda and UN-Habitat Strategic Plan 2020-2025, particularly prioritizing the dimension of social inclusion. This dimension is critical for the fulfilment of the commitment under the 2063 Agenda for Sustainable Development that emphasizes that no one should be left behind and focuses on working towards a world in which everyone can benefit from the advantages of sustainable urbanisation.
The study has four main objectives: 1) To identify and characterize key economic corridors in West Africa, assessing their potential as drivers of economic growth, social cohesion, and regional integration; 2) To examine the socio-economic and territorial conditions of the Liptako-Gourma and Kano-Agadez corridors, exploring demographic dynamics, livelihood conditions, and local infrastructure to determine both their development capacities and limitations; 3) To evaluate AfDB’s current operations in these corridors, analyzing their alignment with identified opportunities and risks; and 4) To provide actionable recommendations that reinforce the corridors' contributions to economic growth, social cohesion, and resilience.
The project will employ rigorous methodology, including an extensive review of existing qualitative and quantitative studies from open sources, the Matrix of Function data and a multi-criteria data analysis. In this way, the study will help AfDB prioritize future investments and operations, advancing regional integration and resilience. Through a deeper understanding of these corridors, the project seeks to support AfDB’s mission of reducing vulnerabilities and strengthening the role of economic corridors in fostering prosperity, stability, and peace in West Africa.
